intro: Qatar has spent heavily on sport, hosting the 2022 World Cup and many world championships.

chapters.title: Football
text: Qatar won the Asian Cup in 2019 and again at home in 2024. Its investment fund owns Paris Saint-Germain.

chapters.title: Athletes
text: High jumper Mutaz Essa Barshim shared the Olympic gold in 2021 with Italy's Gianmarco Tamberi. Fares Elbakh won Qatar's first Olympic gold in weightlifting in 2021.
